verse.verse_2: Because a blind man came to him.
verse.verse_3: What made you think that he will not grow in virtue,
verse.verse_4: Or be admonished, and the admonition profit him?
verse.verse_5: As for him who is not in want of any thing,
verse.verse_7: Though it is not your concern if he should not grow (in fulness).
verse.verse_8: As for him who comes to you striving (after goodness),
verse.verse_12: For any one who desires to bear it in mind,
verse.verse_17: Accursed is man. How ungrateful is he!
verse.verse_18: Of what substance God created him?
verse.verse_19: From a single sperm He created, then proportioned him,
verse.verse_20: Then made his passage easy (at birth);
verse.verse_21: He will then send him to death and have him laid in the grave.
verse.verse_22: Then He will raise him up again when He please.
verse.verse_23: But no. He has not fulfilled what was enjoined on him.
verse.verse_24: Let man therefore consider (the sources of) his food.
verse.verse_26: Then We cracked the earth open under pressure (of germination)
verse.verse_32: A provision for you and your cattle.
verse.verse_33: But when the great calamity comes
verse.verse_34: Man will fly from his brother,
verse.verse_36: As well as his wife and children.
verse.verse_37: Each man will have enough cares that day.
verse.verse_38: Many faces will that day be bright,
verse.verse_42: They will be the unbelievers, transgressors.
